features: ⚡️ High-Capacity Charging - Equipped with a 10000mAh battery, Lifelong Flux power bank ensures you can keep your devices charged no matter where you are. Perfect for long flights, road trips, or whenever you need reliable power on the go.

✅ Loaded with Safety Features - The power bank is loaded with safety features like short circuit protection, overload protection, overheat protection, overvoltage protection and overcurrent protection.
💨 Fast Charging Technology - Experience rapid charging with a maximum output of 15 W from the Magsafe charger, and a 22.5W wired speed, making it a premium choice for a fast-charging power bank.

🤏 Compact & Portable Design - Lightweight and compact, with a sturdy build. Our travel power bank is designed for portability, fitting easily into any bag or pocket, making it perfect for on-the-go use.

💡 Packed with essential features for travellers - Features like LED power indicator which helps you monitor the existing battery percentage, it’s sturdy and durable, and designed to withstand daily use. so that you can travel without any hassles.
description: Stay powered anywhere with the Lifelong Flux 10000mAh power bank, built for reliable, on-the-go charging. Featuring 15W MagSafe wireless and 22.5W fast wired output, it ensures quick power delivery. Advanced safety protections keep devices secure, while its compact, durable design fits easily in your pocket. A Digital power indicator helps track battery percentage, making it perfect for travel and everyday use.
